<description>
A follow-up reverting #36057, now that we've branched off for `33.x`.
Also documents `mingw-w64` requirements (#32380).
</description>

diff --git a/doc/build-windows.md b/doc/build-windows.md

 "summary": "Removes the CMake configure-time check for SetThreadDescription in Windows builds and unconditionally calls the function on WIN32 platforms.  "problem": "A temporary configure check for SetThreadDescription was added in #36057 to support older Mingw-w64 toolchains prior to branching release 33.x. Now that master requires Mingw-w64 12.0 or newer, the fallback check is obsolete, the toolchain minimum was undocumented in the build guide, and legacy MSVCRT cross-compilation remained in developer Nix scripts.",
 "card": "Removes the configure-time introspection check for SetThreadDescription and assumes it is available on Windows, documents Mingw-w64 12.0 as the minimum required version, and drops MSVCRT support from the Nix cross-shell. Following the 33.x release branch, master now requires Mingw-w64 >= 12.0, making the compatibility probe introduced in #36057 unnecessary. It is an internal build configuration cleanup and documentation update for Windows cross-compilation.",
